description: What tokenized US stocks cost on Robinhood Chain against their Chainlink price right now: pool price, Chainlink price, the premium in percent and the feed's age, for NVDA, SPY, AAPL, TSLA, GOOGL, META and MSFT. Read from the chain, free, no key and no payment. Over a weekend the feeds stand still and the pools keep trading. usMarketOpen is true during the regular session, 09:30 to 16:00 New York time, Monday to Friday; it does not know exchange holidays or early closes. Prices are in USDG per token with each token's split multiplier applied. Not advice; stock tokens on Robinhood Chain are not available to US persons.
name: brainchain_stock_premiums
title: Stock premiums on Robinhood Chain
